purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly weather observations at the three NYC airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) for January through June 2013, feeding downstream analytics that join weather conditions to flight records by station and time.
usage: Consumers should join on origin and time_hour to relate weather to flight records; treat wind_gust, wind_dir, wind_speed, and pressure as nullable and handle missing readings explicitly rather than assuming zero or imputing a value, since bronze used NA for missing observations; numeric fields are typed as measurement-appropriate DECIMAL rather than the bronze DECIMAL(38,9).
limitations: wind_gust is missing in 74.6% of rows (9702 of 13014) and pressure is missing in 11.5% (1496 of 13014); these are retained as nulls and not imputed. wind_dir (1.68% null, 219 rows) and wind_speed (0.015% null, 2 rows) are also retained nullable. No exact duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0 across 13014 rows), so no deduplication was applied, and the dataset covers only January-June 2013 per the operator context.
